articles.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
articles.snippet: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.

articles.title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
articles.snippet: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
articles.snippet: Police say at least two cases were reported as early as Sept. 10, nearly a month before the wider incident became public.

articles.title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
articles.snippet: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
articles.snippet: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.
